slides.subtitle: AlgoExpert · Very Hard · Linked Lists
slides.narration: Let's solve Node Swap, a very hard linked lists problem. We'll restate the problem, build the intuition, walk through the approach, read the Java solution, and finish with its complexity.

slides.heading: The problem
bullets: Swap every pair of adjacent nodes (not values); return the new head.
